semantic_models.name: sm_production_throughput
semantic_models.description: Semantic model representing hourly production throughput, including good units and scrap.
semantic_models.purpose: Provides normalized throughput metrics for production analysis, OEE, and performance KPIs.

semantic_models.name: sm_machine_usage
semantic_models.description: Semantic model representing machine runtime, planned time, and utilization.
semantic_models.purpose: Feeds availability calculations and machine-level operational KPIs.

semantic_models.name: sm_machine_downtime
semantic_models.description: Semantic model representing machine downtime events, including duration and cause codes.
semantic_models.purpose: Feeds reliability, availability, and downtime analysis.

semantic_models.name: sm_oee_kpi
semantic_models.description: Composite semantic model calculating availability, performance, quality, and OEE.
semantic_models.purpose: Provides unified OEE metrics for operations dashboards and AI reasoning.

semantic_models.name: sm_machine_reliability_kpi
semantic_models.description: Semantic model calculating MTBF, MTTR, and reliability ratios.
semantic_models.purpose: Provides reliability metrics for maintenance planning and predictive analysis.

semantic_models.name: sm_inventory
semantic_models.description: Semantic model representing inventory quantities, adjustments, and physical counts.
semantic_models.purpose: Feeds inventory accuracy, availability, and supply chain KPIs.

semantic_models.name: sm_customer_orders
semantic_models.description: Semantic model representing customer orders, fulfillment status, and lead times.
semantic_models.purpose: Feeds fill rate, backorder analysis, and on-time delivery KPIs.
